domains.name: Healthcare & Wellness
domains.subtitle: Medical & Biotech Innovation
domains.desc: Revolutionize medical access, diagnostic tools, patient care, and biotech solutions through intelligent software and hardware integration.
problemStatements: PS-HC01: AI-Powered Symptom Checker & Triage Assistant - Develop an AI-driven healthcare assistant that helps users understand possible health conditions based on basic symptoms and recommends appropriate next steps according to urgency levels.

PS-HC02: Smart Medication Reminder & Adherence System - Build a medication management application that reminds users about prescribed medicines, dosage schedules, and missed doses to improve medication adherence.

PS-HC03: AI-Based Personal Wellness Monitoring Platform - Create a wellness tracking application that monitors sleep patterns, water intake, physical activity, and stress levels to provide personalized lifestyle recommendations.

domains.name: Cybersecurity
domains.subtitle: Digital Defense & Security
domains.desc: Defend the digital realm. Create zero-trust architectures, threat detection systems, encryption protocols, and privacy-preserving tools.
problemStatements: PS-CS01: AI-Powered Phishing Email & Link Detection System - Develop an intelligent cybersecurity solution that identifies suspicious emails, links, and messages, analyzes potential threats, and explains the associated security risks to users.

PS-CS02: Password Strength & Security Assessment Tool - Build a password security checker that evaluates password strength, detects common vulnerabilities, and provides actionable recommendations to improve password security.

PS-CS03: Intelligent Suspicious Login Detection System - Create a behavior-based security monitoring system that identifies unusual login attempts by analyzing location changes, device information, and login patterns to detect potential unauthorized access.

domains.name: AI & Machine Learning
domains.subtitle: Autonomous & Generative Intelligence
domains.desc: Build the future with multi-agent systems, autonomous decision networks, neural reasoning models, and generative workflows.
problemStatements: PS-AI01: AI-Powered Resume Screening & Candidate Ranking System - Develop an AI-driven recruitment tool that analyzes candidate resumes, matches skills and qualifications against job descriptions, and ranks suitable profiles based on job requirements.

PS-AI02: Intelligent Document Summarization & Action Item Extraction - Build an AI-powered document processing system that converts lengthy documents into concise summaries, extracts key insights, and identifies actionable tasks for improved productivity.

PS-AI03: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Based Document Chatbot - Create an AI chatbot that answers user questions using information retrieved from uploaded documents or a predefined knowledge base, providing context-aware responses with relevant source references.

domains.name: Sustainability
domains.subtitle: Global Impact & Eco Solutions
domains.desc: Develop impactful software addressing UN Sustainable Development Goals, education access, resource distribution, and community challenges.
problemStatements: PS-SU01: Smart Energy Monitoring & Consumption Optimization Dashboard - Develop an intelligent energy monitoring dashboard that analyzes electricity usage patterns, identifies high-consumption areas, and recommends practical strategies to reduce energy consumption and costs.

PS-SU02: AI-Powered Waste Classification & Disposal Assistant - Build an image-based waste classification application that identifies different waste categories, such as biodegradable, recyclable, hazardous, and non-recyclable waste, and recommends appropriate disposal or recycling methods.

PS-SU03: Personal Carbon Footprint Calculator & Reduction Advisor - Create a carbon footprint assessment tool that estimates greenhouse gas emissions based on transportation, electricity consumption, and daily activities, providing personalized recommendations to reduce environmental impact.

domains.name: EdTech & Social Impact
domains.subtitle: Education & Community Solutions
domains.desc: Engineered solutions for carbon tracking, solar/wind optimization, smart energy grids, zero-emission logistics, and eco-tech efficiency.
problemStatements: PS-ES01: AI-Powered Personalized Learning Assistant - Develop an AI-driven learning platform that explains complex academic topics in simple language, adapts explanations to student needs, and generates interactive quizzes to improve understanding and knowledge retention.

PS-ES02: Intelligent Student Performance Analysis & Early Intervention System - Build a student analytics platform that analyzes academic performance, attendance, assessment scores, and learning progress to identify students who may require additional academic support and recommend targeted interventions.

PS-ES03: AI-Based Accessible Learning Content Transformation Platform - Create an accessibility-focused application that converts educational content into simplified text, audio, and multiple languages to support learners with diverse learning needs and improve inclusive education.

domains.name: Open Innovation
domains.subtitle: Open Challenges
domains.desc: A classified mystery domain to be revealed live during the event! Prepare your team for unexpected wild-card innovation challenges.
problemStatements: PS-OI01: Smart Queue Management & Waiting Time Optimization System - Develop an intelligent queue management platform that enables users to book time slots, monitor real-time queue status, estimate waiting times, and reduce congestion in public and private facilities.

PS-OI02: Community-Based Local Issue Reporting & Resolution Platform - Build a location-aware civic issue reporting application that allows users to report problems such as road damage, improper waste disposal, and water leakage, while tracking complaint status, responsible authorities, and resolution progress.

PS-OI03: AI-Powered Meeting Summarization & Action Tracking Assistant - Create an AI-driven meeting assistant that transforms meeting notes or transcripts into concise summaries, key decisions, actionable tasks, assigned owners, and deadlines to improve team productivity and accountability.
